shortBio.en: Sex Pistols drummer; straight eighths as UK punk kit default.
shortBio.zh: Sex Pistols 鼓手；直线八分作为英国朋克鼓组默认。

body.en:
Born 1956. Keeps drums simple and loud behind Jones’s wall and Lydon’s sneer. Remains with Jones as the rhythm/guitar constant through Matlock and Vicious bass chairs.

Method: no progressive fills; tempo up, pocket flat.
body.zh:
1956 年生。在 Jones 墙与 Lydon 冷笑后保持鼓简单且响。跨 Matlock 与 Vicious 贝斯席，与 Jones 同为节奏/吉他常量。

方法：无 progressive 加花；提速、律动扁平。
